mostWorthwhile.text: Making the onion of burning shells was most worthwhile: it brought the separate burning stages together and clarified that they coexist within one star.

leastWorthwhile.text: The repeated compression steps felt somewhat predictable, even though their explanations distinguished the stages.

surprise.text: I was interested that the triple-alpha process makes carbon through an unstable intermediate, and that carbon burning has several reaction channels.

arbitrary.text: Combining two burning layers into an onion felt slightly abstract, though the result explained the intended metaphor.
